text: I'm sorry to leave a negative review but I had contacted the developer some time ago asking him for a fundamental change in my opinion. But the app stayed the same... (The series of finished events should and therefore the related reward should be based on consecutiveness and not cumulativity)
author: Giovanni Diana
developer_reply: Hi, we apologize to hear about this news. Currently, we are fully engaged in the development of another app and are facing some resource constraints. However, we will do our best to incorporate the feature of event rewards based on continuity in the next version, as it is a highly requested feature by many of our valuable users, including yourself.
